description: Shipping ArcGIS REST map service is a dataset listed in HELCOM Metadata catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by HELCOM Secretariat. This web mapping service contains data and maps related to shipping and pollution response. The service is created with ArcGIS Server 10.9 and can be accessed via ArcGIS REST interface or OGC WMS. The service is used by HELCOM Map and Data service. Coverage: HELCOM Secretariat. The publisher named on the listing is HELCOM Secretariat. Its keywords include ArcGIS REST map service. The listing shows 2021-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-helcom-fi.
